ada:fundingSourceForAnalysis: Planet Topers (BELSPO); FWO; Alexander von Humboldt Foundation; FWO/BOF-UGent
ada:transectLength: Line scan length: 400 µm (runs 1 and 2; 34 runs adjusted to measure 400 µm line + blank + washout)
ada:signalIntegrationTime: Run 1: ~50 s (34 runs covering 400 µm line + 10 s blank + washout); Run 2: same structure; actual integrated signal window within run not separately stated
ada:detectionLimit: LODs reported in Table 1 for line scan + spot trace elements: Na=24, Nb=5 per Longerich et al. 1996; LOQ = 10SD criterion
ada:limitOfQuantificationMethod: LOQ = 10SD of background counts (10σ criterion; Chernonozhkin et al. 2021)
ada:withinSessionAnalyticalPrecisionAndA: LOD calculated per analysis (Na=24, Nb=5); precision not formally reported as separate metric
ada:analyticalAccuracyAndAssessmentMetho: Trace element accuracy verified against literature INAA and EPMA data; major elements verified by comparison with EMPA results from same section

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sample Form / Analytical Substrate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: In situ — polished epoxy thick section; pre-ablated before trace element run

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Sample Preparation Method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: PMG thick sections polished; pre-ablation pass (2 J cm⁻², 20 Hz, 150 µm square, 300 µm s⁻¹) before trace element run

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pre-Ablation Surface Treatment
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Pre-ablation pass: 150 µm square, 2 J cm⁻², 20 Hz, 300 µm s⁻¹ scan before trace element spot run; removes surface contamination and re-deposited material

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Mass Resolution Setting
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Run 1: Medium resolution (M/ΔM = 4000) for major elements; Run 2: Low resolution (M/ΔM = 300) for trace elements

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Laser Spot Geometry
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Run 1 (major): 30 µm circular; Run 2 (trace): 130 µm circular

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Laser Fluence (Energy Density)
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Run 1 (major): 4.72 J cm⁻²; Run 2 (trace): 4.72 J cm⁻²

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Laser Repetition Rate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Run 1 (major): 20 Hz; Run 2 (trace): 40 Hz

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Ablation Duration per Spot
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: N/A (line scan run 1) / N/A (spot run 2 — duration set by 34 runs covering 400 µm + washout, not a fixed spot duration)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Transect Rate, Mapping Rate or Step Size
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: 10 µm s⁻¹ (line scan run 1); spot mode (run 2)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Carrier Gas and Flow Rate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: He: MFC-1 0.19 l min⁻¹; MFC-2 0.22 l min⁻¹

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Plasma / Make-up Gas Addition
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Ar make-up: 0.947 l min⁻¹ (run 1 and run 2); N₂ not added

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Cool: 15 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.90 l min⁻¹ (run 1 and run 2)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Signal Smoothing
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: None

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: ICP Tuning
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Same instrument as mapping; tuning optimized per run (different RF power and resolution settings per run)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Analysis Sequence
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: GRM block (3–5×) → unknowns → GRM block (3–5×); same structure for run 1 and run 2

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Dwell Time per Mass
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Run 1 (major): 0.01 s per nuclide; samples per peak: 18; duty cycle: 2.069 s; Run 2 (trace): 0.01 s per nuclide; samples per peak: 7; duty cycle: 2.062 s

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Background Count Time
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Run 1: 5 gas blank scans; 24 ablation scans; Run 2: 5 gas blank scans; 24 ablation scans

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Uncertainty Propagation Method
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Longerich et al. (1996) for LOD; uncertainty for concentrations not formally described

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Manual inspection; analyses with elevated P, Ca, Co, Ni (phosphate or metal inclusions) excluded; Cr heterogeneities also flagged

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Pulse/Analog Detector Nonlinearity Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Applied: Run 1 medium resolution with Faraday for major elements; Run 2 low resolution; cross-calibration performed

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Memory Effect Mitigation
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Washout time: 11 s between runs (runs include 400 µm line + blank + washout)

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Normalization / Standards-Based Correction
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Run 1: 100% oxide sum normalization; Run 2: Cr IS from Run 1 applied; no further post-acquisition normalization

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Primary Calibration Standard Name
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Same glass GRM set as mapping for Run 1; expanded set additionally includes MPI-DING KL2-G, ML3B-G, StHs6/80-G, T1-G, ATHO-G, BM90/21-G, GOR128-G, GOR132-G for Run 2 trace elements

schema:additionalProperty.schema:name: Secondary Reference Materials
schema:additionalProperty.schema:value: Same GRM set measured as unknowns for accuracy assessment
